name: Sharpshooter
description:
You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible. You gain the following benefits:
- Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
- In place of a weapon attack, you may prepare a shot with a ranged weapon. The next attack you make with the weapon until the end of your turn gains a +5 bonus to its To Hit and damage roll.
snippet: Attacking at long range doesn't impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
